# pip-audit baseline ignore list for the `deps` CI job (cluster C2).
#
# One vulnerability ID per line (e.g. GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx or PYSEC-YYYY-NNN).
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored; the CI step turns every remaining
# line into a `--ignore-vuln <id>` flag.
#
# Add an entry ONLY for a transitive CVE with no fixed release available, and
# note the advisory + reason here so it can be removed once upstream ships a
# fix (tracked in SECURITY.md / C14). Seeded empty: nothing is suppressed yet.
